map.结果与实际压红不一致怎么办？: What if results differ from actual redness?
map.以床旁实际观察为准，工具结果为参考阈值，皮肤苍白或潮红明显时应立即减压并延长观察: Defer to bedside observation; tool results are reference thresholds. On obvious pallor or flushing, relieve pressure immediately and extend observation.
map.小儿或极瘦患者如何取值？: How to score pediatric or very thin patients?
